name: Should I refresh the kitchen or do a full remodel before selling a foreclosed home?

mainEntity.name: Should I refresh the kitchen or do a full remodel before selling a foreclosed home?

acceptedAnswer.text: For budget-conscious owners, a refresh is usually the smarter choice than a complete kitchen rebuild. If you are comparing options, prioritize cabinet refinishing, deep cleaning, hardware updates, and minor repairs before replacing major components that still work.
acceptedAnswer.description: If the kitchen still works, refresh it first. Reserve a full remodel for major damage, failed cabinets, or layouts that cannot be saved with cosmetic work.
